长不大的胡萝卜

一天清晨，
小黄鸡蹦蹦跳跳地穿过院子，
径直来到花园边上，
她一屁股坐在那里，
等待胡萝卜长大。
page_text_en:
The Carrot That Wouldn't Grow

One morning,
the little yellow chick skipped happily across the yard,
straight to the edge of the garden,
sat down right there,
waiting for the carrot to grow.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小黄鸡蹦蹦跳跳地来到花园边，坐下来耐心等待胡萝卜长大的场景。

title_zh: 小黄鸡-凯特格林纳威大奖
title_en: Little Yellow Chick - Kate Greenaway Medal

page_text_ocr_zh:
一会儿，姑妈穿过草坪，
她在花园边停了下来，
低声说：“早啊，小黄鸡。”

“早啊，姑妈，”
小黄鸡轻声回道，
“我在等着我的胡萝卜长大。”
page_text_en:
A while later, Auntie crossed the lawn,
She stopped at the edge of the garden,
And whispered, "Good morning, Little Yellow Chick."

"Good morning, Auntie," 
Little Yellow Chick whispered back,
"I'm waiting for my carrot to grow up."
summary_zh: 姑妈穿过草坪来到花园边，与正在等待胡萝卜长大的小黄鸡打招呼。

page_text_ocr_zh:
“你真是个尽职又耐心的园丁，”
姑妈说。
“没错，”小黄鸡点点头。
“我是个尽职又耐心的园丁。”
姑妈坐下来，和她一起等待胡萝卜长大。
page_text_en:
"You are such a diligent and patient gardener," said Auntie.
"That's right," nodded the little yellow chick.
"I am a diligent and patient gardener."
Auntie sat down and waited with her for the carrots to grow.
summary_zh: 姑妈称赞小黄鸡是个尽职又耐心的园丁，小黄鸡点头同意，并和姑妈一起坐在花园里等待胡萝卜长大。

But the carrot didn't grow.

But the carrot still didn't grow.

Wait and wait......

page_text_ocr_zh:
小黄鸡叹了口气。
“我希望我的胡萝卜长得大一些，”说完，
她靠在姑妈身上。

“胡萝卜长得大当然好，”
姑妈说。
但她又轻声道，
“但有时候，
你只需要一根小小的胡萝卜就够了。”
page_text_en:
The little yellow chick sighed.
"I hope my carrot grows a bit bigger," she said, leaning against her aunt.

"It's certainly good for the carrot to grow big,"
the aunt said.
But then she whispered softly,
"But sometimes,
you only need a tiny little carrot."
summary_zh: 小黄鸡因胡萝卜未长大而叹气，姑妈安慰她，有时小小的胡萝卜就足够了。

page_text_en:

Although it looked very small...
she really needed this carrot.
So the little yellow chick pulled the carrot

飞不起来的风筝

太阳炙烤着大地，
草地一片绿油油。
小黄鸡蹦蹦跳跳地穿过院子，手里扯着风筝线。
“飞呀！”她叫道，“飞到空中！”
但是小黄鸡的风筝没有飞起来。
page_text_en:
The Kite That Wouldn't Fly

The sun was baking the earth,
and the grass was lush and green.
The little yellow chick skipped happily across the yard, holding the kite string.
"Fly!" she called, "Fly into the air!"
But the little yellow chick's kite didn't fly.
summary_zh: 本页描绘了小黄鸡在阳光明媚的院子里放风筝，她兴奋地拉着风筝线，呼喊着让风筝飞起来，但风筝最终没有飞上天空。

风筝只是扑棱扑棱地拖在地上。
姑妈过来给她加油鼓劲儿。
“下午好啊，小黄鸡。”
page_text_en:
The kite just dragged along the ground, flapping.
Auntie came over to cheer her up.
"Good afternoon, little yellow chick."
summary_zh: 小黄鸡试图放风筝，但风筝只是在地上拖行，姑妈走过来为她加油鼓劲并打招呼。

“我跑得很专业呢。”

风筝只是扑棱扑棱地拖在地上。

“我想让我的风筝飞起来，”她说。
page_text_en:
The kite just flopped and dragged on the ground.
Little Yellow Chick sighed.
She was too lazy to run anymore,

So she stopped in place and leaned against Auntie.
"I want my kite to fly," she said.

星空

The little yellow chick stood on the steps, looking up at the sky,
"I want to pick that star!" she shouted.
